column1: # workspace-probe-retirements.tsv — A PROBE IS RETIRED BY ITS OWN AUTHOR, HERE.
# Read by engine/scripts/workspace-probes.py. TWO shapes, both live:
#     <probe filename>
#     <probe filename>
# PER CASE IS THE ONE TO USE. Retirement used to be keyed on the FILE, and a
# reviewer who found three of his cases obsolete and one still valid therefore
# wrote NOTHING -- retiring his file would have dropped five GREEN assertions to
# buy one green exit code. He was right to refuse that trade; the mechanism was
# what made it a trade. Per case, the probe goes on running and only the retired
# cases are not asked. `*` in the case field is the explicit whole-file form.
# THE THREE-FIELD LINES BELOW ARE NOT REWRITTEN AND MUST NOT BE. The runner
# derives the commit that introduced each line and refuses a retirement whose
# only witness is the branch under test; reformatting a reviewer's line would make
# the ENGINEER the author of that commit, and the reviewer's own retirement would
# then be refused. Only this comment block changed.
# The runner checks <who> against the author the probe's own file name carries
# and REFUSES a retirement signed by anyone else. It then asks git three things
# the party failing the probe cannot answer from inside its own work: the line is
# COMMITTED, its commit touches nothing outside docs/verification/, and that
# commit is contained in a branch other than the one under test. An engineer
# failing a probe is the person least able to tell "this assertion is obsolete"
# from "I broke it", so a retirement is never his to write -- and a typed name
# was never proof that it was not.

column3: Obsolete: its premise is attribution by POSSESSION, which I certified at b728514b and which 84e12d32 replaced with attribution by recorded CREATION, with my agreement in certification-sage-recorded-attribution-2026-09-12.md ("The mechanism is right"). Its harness drives barrier() alone and never observe(), so under the Pre/Post pair every scenario now reports created_branches [] and the probe observes nothing. Its RED is a second obsolescence on top of that: two scenarios call land() outside a try and the fixture records no integration branch, which point 14 has required before the first spawn since 2bc413df. Recording it makes all eight scenarios exit 0 — measured, and the output is in certification-sage-runner-round-2026-09-12.md. It asserts nothing by construction (the runner calls this shape OBSERVED), so nothing is carried forward.
